name: v0.8.82
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.82

Released on 2026-09-28.

Renders now match the preview more closely in video frames, fonts and shader transitions. Studio plays back and seeks faster, and the CLI can transcribe with Parakeet after an opt-in install.

## Features

- **Core:** Export findProjects to list the HyperFrames projects on a machine ([e738e10267](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e738e1026793d144e95803a3a575fe448c07d90f), [#4627](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4627)).
- **CLI:** Tag telemetry and feedback with the app that launched the CLI ([fa044a89e5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa044a89e56239225daef39e4904bde2d9442ed5), [#4632](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4632)).
- **Studio:** Let a host app mount the timeline toolbar, undo buttons, meters and clipboard ([bc73c411f0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc73c411f0bbf2b5e79c362ec78300ff5f08c520), [#4629](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4629)).
- **CLI:** Transcribe with Parakeet on macOS, Linux and Windows after an opt-in install ([5cbef29d3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5cbef29d3add1b40d08bcdf2c1ffcf758b8b7f5d), [#4583](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4583)).
- **Plugins:** Ship portable agent bundles and installation guides ([0a5e3c7fc4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a5e3c7fc48229adc0db1aca1fe2d3c1d81b0415), [#4608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4608)).

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** Remove the history of a project that no longer exists ([bee6a8e17d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bee6a8e17d9198e734907b06e2c6f167529893e3), [#4634](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4634)).
- **Producer:** Gif renders survive rgb frames among transparent ones ([5383e486bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5383e486bbc6781300ea3e6491affc4231ca337a), [#4610](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4610)).
- **Studio:** A resize after a drag writes its keyframe below the timeline it uses ([e7a0b6be2c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e7a0b6be2c5b29c7e3ed2ba080e2c93f27b890d2), [#4638](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4638)).
- **Lint:** Studio's lint panel and the CLI label a finding by the composition it names ([27f1cfd23e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/27f1cfd23eaccbab472c46623a3b159e88545240), [#4618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4618)).
- **Studio:** Even out levels lifts the right part of a sped-up or slowed clip ([ea494b4672](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea494b4672371660e9fa31a5671d087fd3e56905), [#4636](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4636)).
- Run the configured ffmpeg and ffprobe everywhere and say when an upload was not checked ([7fedc689b8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7fedc689b82417520b444c32ad71c847a1d33e17), [#4611](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4611)).
- **Studio:** A host that swaps its multi-clip trim handler gets the new one ([ff14263c03](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff14263c03394de98a4372d34b888f4f048a4afe), [#4630](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4630)).
- **Studio:** Playback keys do nothing while a dialog is open ([358c04e2e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/358c04e2e214eacf35a41ba057ebe7f51a9aee5e), [#4623](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4623)).
- **Lint:** Warn when a clip ends past the root composition duration ([13bee74960](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13bee74960b089339d9606f9860e607f206b3fa2), [#4633](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4633)).
- **Studio:** The live clip list carries mute, volume and sound, and refreshes on change ([f55c0bbcb4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f55c0bbcb49274eb23eff8cebefc76712bf0cce0), [#4626](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4626)).
- **Release:** Name Release once in a changelog entry's tags ([b41ef425cc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b41ef425cc0700f6a5d8d29b23a812af2f2f2f06), [#4567](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4567)).
- **Producer:** Renders use the font named in a var() fallback ([04d56d06aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04d56d06aa2c9485c7c36e58fc74c224efdf7119), [#4619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4619)).
- **Shader Transitions:** Shader transitions in renders keep scene layout, styles and animations ([4094c7be4c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4094c7be4c4f5aa63e1641fe028dbff4826513a4), [#4615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4615)).
- **Studio:** Read and write a clip's in-point the way playback does ([2ebfcc04a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ebfcc04a3c220be4cff0cd6d547cdbb54cda5b2), [#4624](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4624)).
- **Lint:** A missing image, audio or mask file names the composition that references it ([7eb00137a2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7eb00137a22e27a8a746ce0a788ac4ad6981613c), [#4616](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4616)).
- **CLI:** Commands exit right away even when the network or DNS is broken ([693c385508](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/693c38550888f6aa4277d4e4fb4bac8c77177316), [#4604](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4604)).
- **Layout:** Flag text a clipping card cuts off ([09ab947e1a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09ab947e1ad0c00cad75515481d7742a2cf6e405), [#4577](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4577)).
- **Studio Server:** Background removal writes only where it checked, even through planted links ([03e3755aaa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03e3755aaacff101e8b760329d3dc0622341d34a), [#4540](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4540)).
- **Producer:** Embed the Google font the page linked instead of a wider cut ([918e39e785](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/918e39e78575ebf277b01546a017245ee2492bcc), [#4569](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4569)).
- **Engine:** Renders show the video frame the preview shows at each output frame ([e8313b2b39](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8313b2b39674816a6057f4735f0f93df5b21fa1), [#4596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4596)).
- **Studio:** Timeline clip pictures fit the clip instead of zooming in ([e188dc0a0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e188dc0a0a5395242d7ecc6249782d9d428d1d8d), [#4582](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4582)).
- **Studio:** Quick saves no longer refuse each other as outside changes ([d4801086c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4801086c4b859a282a5cd895cf54f6ac0d1b98b), [#4612](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4612)).
- **Skills:** Keep plugin workflows on their installed release ([ff6e2103d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff6e2103d7d7eda5f3515005abd2e393ac38c7b6), [#4607](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4607)).

## Performance

- **Core:** Playback housekeeping runs on a timer, and rebinds stop re-sampling silent media ([4ed269ad1e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ed269ad1e3df0f948ded6320be08cb1058910db), [#4595](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4595)).
- **Studio:** A film with no manual edits skips the edit reapply on each seek ([e1e2b16e21](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1e2b16e2191452db76e76043b1cda9189516e33), [#4592](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4592)).
- The preview loads and decodes only the images of scenes on screen or due next ([078c493448](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/078c493448cf73241bd9eb885a206ea1ccd951cc), [#4578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4578)).
- **Studio:** Playback no longer relayouts the timecode and playhead every frame ([471e90c057](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/471e90c057f799fbe7bdb1b03c53bef8e6a46d28), [#4593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4593)).

## Docs & Examples

- **CLI:** Render help says when page-side compositing is actually used ([a380036903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a380036903bbef90b06c11ead21f93136b05b761), [#4572](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4572)).

## Internal

- **Producer:** Run the late-host pip and dogs-captions fixtures in CI ([625b07fe2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/625b07fe2d49d956423bdacb22c50912ae982719), [#4625](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4625)).
- **Studio Server:** A write landing between Studio's read and its patch survives undo ([a845c322b9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a845c322b9bc54df6b7a6f99a6e511815bb8d751), [#4622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4622)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.81...v0.8.82

name: v0.8.81
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.81

Released on 2026-09-27.

Projects updated from 0.8.78 keep their full edit history again, and a host app can now make Cmd+Z undo the newest change whoever made it. Studio also lists only real compositions, and SDR renders keep the source colours.

## Features

- **Studio Server:** A host can make Cmd+Z undo the newest change, whoever made it ([b165b64ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b165b64eda845f46f9b622b96e4545bf704d0950), [#4603](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4603)).

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** History saved by 0.8.78 survives the update with every entry ([3db3da7bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3db3da7bb284c5f0d89a1f7507d96115236e6bfc), [#4601](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4601)).
- **CLI:** A failed command sends one error report, naming its real cause ([627e9476a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/627e9476af1c3feeb4359808a9f455a645b0697d), [#4586](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4586)).
- **Studio:** List and grade only real compositions, not generated preview files ([3855623dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3855623dd93065ba1c5b2c8b2dfd005853636b91), [#4590](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4590)).
- **Studio Server:** A write through a link lands on the file the system resolves ([59e3850f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59e3850f6a54f4d853b6cbc9af11032c05dbe2b6), [#4589](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4589)).
- **Engine:** SDR renders keep footage and page colours as in the source ([c9b3d9c96](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9b3d9c9628d4c51696147ecd2fd881080e72824), [#4564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4564)).

## Performance

- **Studio:** The lint error badge pulses three times, then holds ([d6e8542a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d6e8542a380107c9843a83d2c595413f9e2a25c3), [#4594](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4594)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** CLI tests run with a home folder of their own, never the user's ([2b1bb8b73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b1bb8b731e0445081cd2a1d526f7f83df41cdcb), [#4587](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4587)).

## Full changelog

name: GPUI Kit v0.7.0
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.7.0 GPUI Kit v0.7.0 adds Toolbar, Questionnaire and TimeField, and makes window startup and overlay hosting consistent through a Base-owned Root. Plot primitives are now available without the styled component layer, while Input, TextView and charts gain richer editing, search, date/time and data-visualization APIs. This release also improves Dock interactions, accessibility, streaming and large-data performance; review the Breaking Changes below before upgrading. ## New components - **Toolbar and ToolbarGroup**: compose application command rows with source-order controls, semantic groups, separators and flexible spacers. Left/Right moves focus through enabled controls with wrapping. The styled toolbar propagates its density to hosted controls and gives Buttons compact ghost presentation; `child`/`children` accept sized controls, while `content`/`contents` accept labels, separators and custom content. The default size is Small; XSmall and Medium are supported, and Large uses Medium. Disabling toolbar navigation does not disable its controls automatically. ([#3128](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3128)) - **Questionnaire**: build single-choice, multiple-choice and freeform questionnaires around `QuestionnaireState`, with composable question, choice, input, progress and action parts. The component handles validation, optional skipping, keyboard shortcuts, focus, navigation and submission, using existing Radio, Checkbox, Input and Button controls. ([#2878](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/2878)) - **TimeField and date/time picking**: edit segmented hours and minutes, optionally seconds, using `TimeFieldState`, `TimePrecision::{Minute, Second}` and `HourCycle::{H23, H12}`. A styled TimeField works independently in forms, and DatePicker enables time editing through `time_precision`, `hour_cycle` and `default_time`. `date_time`/`set_date_time` expose the combined value; date/time presets use `DateRangePreset::date_time`. In time-enabled single mode, each edit emits Change while the popup stays open; range mode remains date-only. DatePicker Change payloads require migration below. ([#3206](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3206)) ## Window hosting and framework boundaries - **One window entry point**: `gpui_kit::open_window(options, cx, build)` returns `(AnyWindowHandle, Entity)` and always wraps application content in `gpui_base::Root`, independent of Cargo feature unification. Call `gpui_kit::init(cx)` first, return content from the builder, and retain the returned entity when you need application state. In async work, invoke the helper inside `cx.update`; quit/close actions and keybindings remain application-owned. ([#3152](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3152)) - **Automatic overlay hosting**: Root owns content, overlay hosting, keyboard traversal and selection copying; `gpui_component::Root` re-exports the Base type. Component initialization registers per-window presentation for dialogs, sheets, notifications, menus, tooltips, touch selection and window chrome. Manual layer-rendering APIs are removed; application operations remain on `WindowExt`. ([#3152](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3152)) - **Root plugins**: design systems can register typed `RootPlugin` implementations with `Root::register_plugin`, retrieve them with `Root::plugin`, and use preparation, styling and decoration hooks. Plugins are instantiated per window in registration order. Register them before creating windows; replacing a factory affects future windows, and existing roots are not retrofitted. ([#3152](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3152)) - **Plot primitives in Base**: scales, shapes, axes, grids, labels, the `Plot` trait, path caches and hover tracking move to `gpui_kit::base::plot`, enabling custom charts without a Component dependency. Existing `gpui_kit::component::plot` imports remain available through re-exports. `PlotElement

` is the element behind custom plots and `#[derive(IntoPlot)]`; `PlotMotion` and `PlotTheme` provide theme-projected pointer and hover motion. Base defaults to no motion, styled charts now accept `f32`, and Component forwards its `decimal` feature to Base. Custom primitive APIs require migration below. ([#3258](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3258)) ### Simplified window startup `gpui_kit::init(cx)` and `gpui_kit::open_window` provide a compact, standard startup sequence. The builder creates application content, and Kit supplies the Root and automatically hosts dialogs, sheets and notifications. Use `WindowExt` for Component operations, `gpui_base::TextSelection` for selection, and `WindowOptions` with `window_border()` for window decoration. ([#3152](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3152)) ```rust gpui_kit::init(cx); let (window_handle, content) = gpui_kit::open_window(options, cx, |window, cx| { build_content(window, cx) })?; ``` ### Updating existing window code The following examples show how existing startup, overlay and window-operation code maps to the simplified APIs. ```diff - cx.open_window(options, |window, cx| { - let content = build_content(window, cx); - cx.new(|cx| Root::new(content, window, cx)) - }) + let (window_handle, content) = + gpui_kit::open_window(options, cx, |window, cx| { + build_content(window, cx) + })?; ``` ```diff - let sheet_layer = Root::render_sheet_layer(window, cx); - let dialog_layer = Root::render_dialog_layer(window, cx); - let notification_layer = Root::render_notification_layer(window, cx); - div() .child(content) - .children(sheet_layer) - .children(dialog_layer.map(|layer| deferred(layer).with_priority(1))) - .children(notification_layer) ``` ```diff - Root::bordered - Root::window_shadow_size + window_border() ``` ```diff - window.selected_text(cx) + TextSelection::selected_text(window, cx) - window.has_text_selection(cx) + TextSelection::has_selection(window, cx) - root.clear_text_selection(window, cx) - window.clear_text_selection(cx) + TextSelection::clear(window, cx) - window.end_text_selection(cx) + TextSelection::end(window, cx) ``` ```diff - root.open_dialog(build, window, cx) + window.open_dialog(cx, build) - root.close_dialog(window, cx) + window.close_dialog(cx) - root.close_all_dialogs(window, cx) + window.close_all_dialogs(cx) - root.open_sheet_at(placement, build, window, cx) + window.open_sheet_at(placement, cx, build) - root.close_sheet(window, cx) + window.close_sheet(cx) - root.push_notification(notification, window, cx) + window.push_notification(notification, cx) - root.remove_notification::(window, cx) + window.remove_notification::(cx) - root.remove_notification1::(key, window, cx) + window.remove_notification1::(key, cx) - root.clear_notifications(window, cx) + window.clear_notifications(cx) ``` ## Editor and text input - **Atomic inline tokens**: Input and Textarea can represent mentions, commands and resource references as `InlineToken` annotations. Use `replace_with_token`/`replace_range_with_token` to insert them, `InputContent::with_token` to restore validated ranges, and `content()` to save a draft. Caret movement, selection, deletion and undo treat each token as one unit, while values and clipboard content remain plain text. Customize presentation with `token` and activation with `on_token_click` or `ActivateToken`. Tokens are opt-in and unavailable in Editor, NumberInput, password and formatted-mask modes. ([#3113](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3113)) - **Editor range decorations**: independent consumers can create edit-tracked `RangeDecorationCollection` handles through `EditorState::create_range_decorations_collection`. `RangeDecoration` supports `RangeDecorationStyle::{Fill, Frame}` with optional color; collections can set, append, clear, read tracked ranges or dispose. Decorations use UTF-8 byte ranges and paint only visible spans, including soft wraps, CRLF and folded text. `InputExtras::range_decorations` has a default empty implementation, so existing implementers continue to compile. ([#3040](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3040)) - **Textarea sizing and editor gutters**: Textarea supports the standard size system like Input, and the line-number gutter adapts between three and seven digits instead of reserving an unsuitable fixed width. ([#3191](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3191), [#3205](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3205)) - **Focus, selection and asynchronous editing**: corrected disabled-input pointer focus, preferred columns and vertical selection affinity, drag-selection autoscroll, stale completion/inline responses, IME selection direction and undo boundaries, replacement-field focus and explicit GoToDefinition requests. Accessibility Focus refuses disabled inputs; SetValue is advertised and applied only when editable. Re-requesting code actions refreshes an already-open menu, including empty results. ([#3254](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3254), [#3256](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3256), [#3274](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3274)) - **Caret lifecycle and navigation**: programmatic updates no longer start permanent blink/repaint loops on unfocused inputs; blur clears stale blink state so refocusing restores a blinking caret. Editing scrolls directly to a distant caret rather than animating through the whole document. ([#3139](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3139), [#3140](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3140), [#3150](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3150)) - **Web clipboard paste**: Input context menus offer Paste whenever the input is editable, and fall back to asynchronous clipboard reading when synchronous reading is unavailable. The paste request starts from the user action and rechecks editability when it resolves. ([#3244](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3244)) - **Editor performance and Unicode safety**: reduce diagnostic/definition-hover repaints, debounce transient hover requests, avoid inactive search rescans and query only visible search highlights. Syntax classification reuses Rope-backed parse results and injection trees. Tree-sitter receives bytes, preventing aborts when a read begins inside a multibyte character. ([#3260](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3260), [#3263](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3263), [#3238](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3238)) - **Input context menus**: documentation now makes clear that `InputState::context_menu(false)` disables the entire right-click menu, including a custom Input/Textarea/Editor menu. Keep the state menu enabled when supplying a custom builder; the builder replaces the built-in items. ([#3275](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3275)) ## Markdown and text rendering - **Source-aware selection**: `TextViewState::selected_source_range()` returns the original Markdown byte range for the actual rendered selection, distinguishing repeated occurrences instead of guessing from selected text. ([#3136](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3136)) - **Search highlights and reveal**: search `TextViewState::rendered_text()` and apply `RangeHighlight` values with `set_range_highlights`; `clear_range_highlights` removes them. Ranges refer to UTF-8 bytes in rendered copy text, so searches can cross Markdown formatting. Highlights preserve layout, selection and copy behavior, and survive unchanged content and append-only streaming. `reveal_range` makes the starting line visible in a scrollable TextView or an application list; `TextView::on_reveal` supplies window-space bounds for custom scroll containers. Reveal is best effort, and highlights are currently Markdown-only. ([#3215](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3215), [#3216](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3216)) - **Heading refinements**: Base `TextViewStyle::with_heading` accepts a level-aware `StyleRefinement` callback for typography, spacing, color and borders, layered over built-in heading defaults. Component keeps its existing compatibility heading fields and builders. ([#3129](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3129)) - **Markdown correctness**: preserve ordered-list starting numbers and prose in unclaimed math spans, pair inline HTML tags correctly, and keep lines containing inline code as tall as equivalent plain-text lines. ([#3204](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3204), [#3178](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3178), [#3240](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3240)) - **Streaming and large documents**: `stream_fade` staggers by word and skips oversized chunks, with throttled repaints. Reuse inline layout and paragraph render caches, avoid unnecessary hover/selection work, and remove quadratic source-mapping and table-highlight reconciliation paths. Text selection in a cached dock view stays registered instead of flickering and keeping the window repainting. ([#3153](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3153), [#3226](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3226), [#3180](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3180), [#3261](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3261), [#3247](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3247), [#3273](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3273), [#3193](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3193)) ## Charts and plot motion - **Stable live-series geometry**: LineChart and AreaChart support `y_domain(min, max)` for a fixed value range and `point_count(count)` for reserved x-axis slots, so arriving data keeps its position. Values outside the fixed domain are clipped. BarChart adds `band_count` for the equivalent fixed-band layout. ([#3209](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3209), [#3220](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3220)) - **Axes, grids and reference lines**: LineChart/AreaChart add `y_axis`, `y_axis_label_placement`, `y_tick_count`, `y_tick_format`, `x_tick_count`, `grid_columns`, `grid_dashed`, repeatable `reference_line` and `y_padding`. BarChart adds `value_axis_label_placement`, `value_tick_format`, `band_tick_count` and `grid_dashed`. `AxisLabelPlacement::{Outside, Inside}` controls value-label placement. `chart.grid`/`ThemeColor::chart_grid` separate grids from axis borders, with a 60%-opacity border fallback for themes that omit the token. ([#3220](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3220), [#3236](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3236)) - **Bar labels and spacing**: `label_color` colors labels per datum, `padding_inner`/`padding_outer` expose band spacing, and `min_length` keeps zero or small bars visible. Vertical charts reserve space for labels. BarChart and CandlestickChart expose `max_band_width`, retaining their default 30px maximum while Base ScaleBand no longer imposes one. ([#3217](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3217), [#3258](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3258)) - **Tooltip customization**: LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, RadarChart and CandlestickChart add `tooltip_title`, `tooltip_value`, `tooltip_value_color` and `tooltip_content`. Multivalue chart callbacks also receive a row index. PieChart and SankeyChart add `tooltip_name`/`tooltip_value` independently of labels painted on the chart. `Tooltip::value_color` colors the latest row and `plain_row` adds totals without a swatch; a bar tooltip swatch follows the bar color. ([#3228](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3228), [#3176](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3176)) - **Interaction and motion**: chart IDs default to their construction site so hover works without an explicit ID; provide distinct IDs when multiple charts share a construction site. `interactive(false)` removes hitboxes, hover emphasis, tooltips and path caches for placeholders or covered charts. Tooltip glides its own crosshair/dots and grows dot halos with hover progress; `Tooltip::glide(false)` disables that spring. Custom plots can use `PlotHover::glide` and the Base hover-motion helpers. ([#3173](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3173), [#3176](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3176), [#3222](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3222), [#3258](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3258)) - **Painting performance**: LineChart and AreaChart use index-based point placement to avoid quadratic value lookups and correctly position duplicate x values at their own indices. Candlestick wicks avoid per-candle path tessellation, and chart hover/painting avoids redundant work. ([#3262](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3262)) ## Dock and resizing - **Nested docks and tab closing**: moving a panel from a dock that does not own it no longer creates duplicate or ghost tabs. `DockSkin::set_close_button_visible` enables built-in close buttons, hidden by default; `TabGroupContext::is_panel_closable` respects both dock and panel constraints. Custom tab renderers retain control over presentation and frame geometry. ([#3197](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3197)) - **Continuous bottom-dock resizing**: drag a collapsible bottom dock below its minimum, through the closed strip and back open in one motion. Release snaps to the nearer closed or minimum-open state; transient sizes below the minimum are not persisted. Custom resize drivers finish with `DockContext::end_resize`. ([#3229](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3229)) - **Resize indicators**: dividers grow their indicator as the pointer engages, hugging handles paint their hairline on the seam, and dock hairlines no longer draw over popovers. ([#3175](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3175), [#3200](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3200), [#3221](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3221)) ## Theme synchronization - **Theme updates**: `Theme::update(cx, |theme| ...)` edits the global theme, reconciles solid colors and gradient tokens, updates the Base projection, resolves changed fonts and refreshes all windows. Use it for palette, mode, typography and other theme edits instead of manually synchronizing each representation. `Theme::global_mut` and `Theme::sync_base` remain available for callers that manage synchronization themselves. ([#3122](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3122)) ## Components and accessibility - **Popover trigger styling**: `Popover::trigger_style` now applies to the actual trigger container, so width/flex refinements affect both parent layout and popup anchoring. Base Popover implements Styled; DropdownMenu keeps Button styling on the Button instead of applying it twice. ([#3245](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3245)) - **Attachment**: composer attachments include `on_remove`, `on_retry`, `progress(percent)` and `tooltip`; interactive controls and tooltips require `id`. Progress is 0–100 and clamped. Media receives correctly rounded corners and upload/failure treatments, including retry when a failed image has no source. `AttachmentGroup::track_scroll` lets the application drive scrolling and `with_edge_fade` signals clipped attachments. Default chip geometry and failure styling change to the composer presentation. ([#3195](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3195), [#3233](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3233)) - **Settings and GroupBox**: `GroupBox::footer`/`SettingGroup::footer` place supporting content outside the group surface. `SettingGroup::variant` overrides the `Settings::with_group_variant` default for one group; `GroupBoxVariant::Normal` presents items without a card surface. Selecting a group on another settings page now scrolls to the intended group. ([#3133](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3133), [#3203](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3203), [#3219](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3219)) - **Table**: `TableSelection::{None, Row, Column, Cell}` with `TableState::selection`/`set_selection` models the active selection as one value. Positional getters return only the active selection type; stale row appearance and accessibility selection state are corrected. Filler rows and cell rendering avoid redundant work. ([#3143](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3143), [#3264](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3264)) - **Popover**: `offset` sets the trigger gap and `arrow(true)` adds an arrow for all eight anchors. Horizontal-center anchor placement is corrected. Popover/AppMenu triggers use the new default `Selectable::open`/`is_open` methods to distinguish an open popup from application selection; existing Selectable implementations retain the default compatibility behavior. ([#3145](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3145), [#3125](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3125)) - **Dialog**: `button_props` merges explicitly supplied fields, preserving existing Cancel visibility and callbacks. AlertDialog adds `ok_text`, `ok_variant`, `cancel_text` and `cancel_variant`. Oversized dialogs reclaim the upper window space while normal and stacked dialogs retain their preferred placement. ([#3126](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3126), [#3188](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3188)) - **Select**: closing an open menu emits `DismissEvent`, including after Confirm; the popup aligns with the trigger at the right edge. Long option labels truncate with an ellipsis while keeping the checkmark visible. Custom full-row renderers receive a shrinkable container and should apply text truncation themselves. ([#3144](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3144), [#3218](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3218), [#3280](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3280)) - **Menus**: context-menu actions fire once on the row actually pressed even when rows share a construction site. PopupMenu, DropdownMenu and Popover release their entities and subscriptions when their host disappears, preventing leaks and stale popup registrations from suppressing later Input context menus. ([#3135](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3135), [#3224](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3224), [#3267](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3267), [#3279](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3279)) - **Switch**: the track shows a keyboard focus ring, with `focus_ring(false)`, `tab_stop` and `tab_index` controls. Long labels no longer shrink the track. ([#3120](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3120), [#3154](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3154)) - **Sidebar and List**: SidebarMenuItem exposes its visible label, TreeItem role and selected state to assistive technology. SidebarMenuItem, ListItem and SidebarToggleButton accept `accessibility_label`. The focused ListState container carries the List role, and a right-clicked list item retains its outline. ([#3160](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3160), [#3249](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3249), [#3155](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3155)) - **Chat composition**: `Marker::alignment(MarkerAlignment::{Start, Center, End})` controls row and wrapped-text alignment across variants. `Message::id`/`role` provide stable accessibility identity; Message content inherits caller/bubble typography. Ghost Bubble children are no longer clipped. ([#3151](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3151), [#3171](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3171), [#3172](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3172)) - **Form**: caller styling such as padding, gaps and background takes effect, and `Field::visible(false)` actually hides fields without leaving empty grid rows. Hidden fields are not built or laid out. ([#3248](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3248), [#3269](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3269)) ## Performance and resource use - **Command**: unchanged command models retain their measured rows and search results across parent rerenders, while new callbacks and selection updates still apply. Models with custom child closures or changed layout continue to remeasure. ([#3268](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3268)) - **Tree and SearchableVec**: visible tree rows avoid deep subtree clones and defer context-menu entry cloning until the menu opens. SearchableVec filters by indices instead of cloning matching items or entire groups, evaluating each match once. ([#3265](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3265), [#3279](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3279)) - **Carousel and Rating**: ancestor scrolling no longer rebuilds Carousel geometry or interrupts a running snap animation. Rating repaints on real hover-value changes rather than every pointer movement. ([#3266](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3266), [#3270](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3270)) - **Pagination, ColorPicker, Accordion and Notification**: ellipsis menus show at most the 100 hidden pages nearest the current page; closed ColorPicker popups defer their bodies; Accordion content unmounts after the closing spring settles; persistent notifications stop lifecycle ticking once transitions finish. See the Accordion state-lifetime note below. ([#3279](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3279)) ## Shell, runtime and platform - **GPUI snapshot**: Kit now pins the complete `gpui-pre-*` snapshot family to `=0.3.7`, including the newly published bench-metrics package. All 25 snapshot packages resolve together; the independent `gpui-pre-reqwest` fork remains at 0.12.15. ([#3283](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3283)) - **Shell inline tokens and TimeField**: JavaScript InputState/TextareaState mirror token insertion, draft content, token slots and token click callbacks. JavaScript ranges use UTF-16 offsets, while Rust uses UTF-8 bytes; validation failures expose `error.code`. Shell also exposes TimeField state/elements. Host integration adds optional retained-state methods via `StateMethodDescriptor`/`StateDescriptor::with_methods` and frame-owned interactive token subtrees. ([#3113](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3113), [#3206](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3206)) - **Script image policy**: HTML/Markdown TextView document images obey the creating script's HTTP GET capabilities, including intrinsic-size measurement and every redirect. Loading is asynchronous, view-owned and canceled on disposal, with timeout/body/redirect limits and no HTTPS downgrade. Non-HTTP(S) document images, including data URLs, are refused; the application-asset `image(path)` API is unchanged. Base adds a narrow document-image source override for embedders. ([#3230](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3230)) - **Base controls**: Base Dialog centers a normal-flow popup by default and blocks popup presses from reaching its backdrop; Base AlertDialog implements Styled. Base single-line Input vertically centers its text within its frame, while multiline layout is unchanged. These defaults do not alter styled Component Dialog/Input placement. ([#3277](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3277), [#3278](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3278)) - **Web and touch**: Base WASM examples bundle IBM Plex Sans so `.SystemUIFont` resolves and canvases render. Centered notification stacks work reliably on the web. A short touch drag that catches an active ScrollBounce no longer produces a reverse fling; intentional longer flings and edge bounce are preserved. ([#3235](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3235), [#3149](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3149), [#3207](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3207)) ## Documentation and website - **Versioned documentation**: the latest release is served at `/`, development docs at `/versions/main`, and release snapshots at `/versions/`. Snapshot isolation and version-local links prevent newer pages or navigation from leaking into older docs; shared WASM examples load from the site root, and historical versions without component pages still build. ([#3159](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3159), [#3189](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3189), [#3243](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3243), [#3165](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3165), [#3196](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3196)) - **Framework manual**: expanded bilingual guides cover Entity, Window, Context, Render, RenderOnce, Element, Action/Event, ownership, focus, tasks, painting, text, accessibility, animation and WebAssembly, with runnable exercises and troubleshooting. New Packaging, Auto Update and Images guides cover distribution, user-level Linux installation, embedded assets, `img`, `svg` and HTTP caching. Menu-bar guidance documents binding keys before `set_menus`, and focus guidance explains explicit Tab stops. ([#3179](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3179), [#3181](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3181), [#3225](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3225), [#3232](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3232), [#3239](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3239), [#3124](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3124)) - **Website themes and navigation**: the theme palette reads theme JSON directly, previews and confirms with keyboard navigation, restores on cancel, and synchronizes the chosen JSON with embedded WASM examples. `Cmd+K`/`Ctrl+K` opens theme selection; `/` opens docs search. Text selection uses `selection.background`, falling back to `primary.background`, and active sidebar entries are easier to identify. Custom website themes and design-guide illustrations are refined. ([#3198](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3198), [#3241](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3241), [#3242](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3242), [#3237](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3237), [#3211](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3211), [#3212](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3212)) - **Documentation licensing**: eligible documentation prose and original illustrations carry CC BY 4.0 attribution; software and code examples retain Apache-2.0 permissions. ([#3225](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3225)) ## Breaking Changes ### Custom Plot primitives Component plot import paths remain re-exported, but custom plots must migrate primitive APIs. `StrokeStyle`/`stroke_style` are removed in favor of `Curve`/`curve`; scale ranges become arrays, domains accept iterators, and `PlotValue` replaces the hidden Sealed bound. `least_index` becomes `nearest_index`; `least_index_with_domain` is removed. Arc paints/contains use the radii configured on the Arc, and Grid x/y accept iterators. ScaleBand has no implicit 30px cap: set `max_band_width` if needed. `TooltipState`, `AxisText`, `label::Text`, `ArcData`, `StackPoint`, `StackSeries`, `SankeyLink`, `SankeyNodeLayout`, `SankeyLinkLayout` and `SankeyGraph` are non-exhaustive and should use their constructors. `PlotAxis::default()` now equals `new()` with its x-axis line visible. IntoPlot derives use `PlotElement` rather than implementing Element directly; the hidden `plot::tooltip::track_hover` is removed. Base Theme struct literals need `plot`. Deprecated aliases remain this release for `AXIS_GAP`, `dot_fill_color`, `dot_stroke_color`, `PlotHover::focus` and `Tooltip::focus`; prefer `axis_gutter`, `dot_fill`, `dot_stroke` and `progress`. Existing chart curve builders remain unchanged. ([#3258](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3258)) ```diff - use gpui_kit::base::plot::StrokeStyle; + use gpui_kit::base::plot::Curve; - Line::new().stroke_style(StrokeStyle::StepAfter) + Line::new().curve(Curve::StepAfter) - Area::new().stroke_style(StrokeStyle::Linear) + Area::new().curve(Curve::Linear) ``` ```diff - let y = ScaleLinear::new(values.collect(), vec![height, 0.]); + let y = ScaleLinear::new(values, [height, 0.]); - where Y: Copy + PartialOrd + Num + ToPrimitive + Sealed + where Y: PlotValue - let ix = scale.least_index(tick); + let ix = scale.nearest_index(tick); - arc.paint(&data, color, None, Some(radius), &bounds, window); + Arc::new().outer_radius(radius).paint(&data, color, &bounds, window); - Grid::new().y(ticks.collect()) + Grid::new().y(ticks) ``` ```diff gpui_base::Theme { appearance, tokens, scrollbar, resizable, + plot: gpui_base::PlotTheme::default(), } ``` ### DatePicker event values `DatePickerEvent::Change` now carries `DateTime`, not `Date`. Date-only consumers can use `value.date()`; `format` keeps its signature. Exhaustive matches on `DateRangePresetValue` must handle the new DateTime variant. ([#3206](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3206)) ```diff cx.subscribe(&picker, |this, _, event, _| match event { - DatePickerEvent::Change(date) => match date { + DatePickerEvent::Change(value) => match value.date() { Date::Single(Some(date)) => { /* … */ } _ => {} }, }); ``` ### Base heading styling Base `TextViewStyle` removes `with_heading_base_font_size`, `heading_base_font_size`, `with_heading_font_size` and `heading_font_size`. Use `with_heading`/`heading` and a StyleRefinement callback. The Component compatibility facade retains its old fields and builders. ([#3129](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3129)) ```diff -TextViewStyle::default() - .with_heading_base_font_size(px(14.)) - .with_heading_font_size(|level, base| resolve_size(level, base)) +TextViewStyle::default().with_heading(|level| { + StyleRefinement::default().text_size(resolve_size(level)) +}) ``` ### Table selection getters Each positional getter reports only its active selection type. To obtain the row of a selected cell, map `selected_cell()` or match `selection()`; keep inactive-selection history in the application if required. ([#3143](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3143)) ```diff table.set_selected_cell(5, 3, cx); -let row = table.selected_row(); +let row = table.selected_cell().map(|(row_ix, _)| row_ix); table.set_selected_row(2, cx); -assert_eq!(table.selected_cell(), Some((5, 3))); +assert_eq!(table.selected_cell(), None); +assert_eq!(table.selection(), TableSelection::Row(2)); ``` ### BarChart tick counts `value_tick_count(n)` now means n ticks, not n intervals. Add one to an explicit old count to preserve its appearance. The default changes from four intervals to five ticks, preserving the default chart layout. ([#3209](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3209)) ```diff - BarChart::new(data).value_axis(true).value_tick_count(6) + BarChart::new(data).value_axis(true).value_tick_count(7) ``` ### Custom tooltip motion Tooltip now springs its own crosshair/dots. Remove a custom spring or use `Tooltip::glide(false)` to avoid applying motion twice. Pass full Dot halo sizes; Tooltip applies hover progress itself. ([#3222](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3222)) ```diff - let center = self.band_center.unwrap_or(state.cross_line.x); - Tooltip::new(cursor, bounds.size) - .cross_line(CrossLine::new(point(center, state.cross_line.y))) + Tooltip::new(cursor, bounds.size) + .cross_line(CrossLine::new(state.cross_line)) ``` ```diff - Dot::new(p).halo(px(20. * hover.focus())) + Dot::new(p).halo(px(20.)) ``` ### Shell document image permissions Script TextView signatures are unchanged, but remote document images now need explicit GET grants for their URL and every redirect target. Non-HTTP(S) sources, including data URLs, are refused; `image(path)` application assets are unaffected. ([#3230](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3230)) ```diff - Policy::new() + Policy::new().with_capabilities(Capabilities::new().http_requests([ + HttpRequestGrant::new("images.example", ["GET"], ["/image.png"], [] as [&str; 0]), + ])) ``` ### Select dismissal ordering Existing DismissEvent subscribers now run when an open menu closes. Confirm emits SelectEvent::Confirm followed by DismissEvent; opening or closing an already-closed menu does not dismiss. ([#3144](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3144)) ```diff // An existing SelectState DismissEvent subscription after Escape: -// No callback. +// One callback after the menu transitions to closed. // After confirming an item: -// SelectEvent::Confirm only. +// SelectEvent::Confirm, then DismissEvent. ``` ### Popover horizontal-center anchors LeftCenter places the popup to the right of the trigger; RightCenter places it to the left, both vertically centered. These no longer fall back to top-left positioning. Top/bottom anchors keep their default placement and do not flip when clamped. ([#3145](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3145)) ```diff - .anchor(Anchor::LeftCenter) // Legacy top-left fallback + .anchor(Anchor::LeftCenter) // Right of the trigger, vertically centered - .anchor(Anchor::RightCenter) // Legacy top-left fallback + .anchor(Anchor::RightCenter) // Left of the trigger, vertically centered ``` ### Individually disabled Accordion items An item marked disabled stays disabled instead of being accidentally enabled by its parent. Explicitly enable it if expansion is intended; builder signatures are unchanged. ([#3141](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3141)) ```diff Accordion::new("settings").item(|item| item.title("Advanced").disabled(true)) -// Clicking Advanced can expand it. +// Clicking Advanced leaves it closed. ``` ### Message typography inheritance Message no longer imposes text_sm and a 1.25 line height on its subtree. Header/footer typography remains local; bare MessageContent inherits the surrounding style, so explicitly style content that depended on the previous row defaults. ([#3171](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3171)) ```diff - Message::new().content(MessageContent::new().child("plain text")) // rendered text_sm / 1.25 + Message::new().content(MessageContent::new().child("plain text")) // inherits the caller's text style ``` ### Base Dialog placement and pointer occlusion Normal-flow Base popups center by default; style the host to recover top-left placement. Popup presses no longer reach the backdrop, so size popup parts to their content instead of using a full-window popup wrapper. Styled Component Dialog positioning is unchanged. ([#3277](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3277)) ```diff - Dialog::new(cx).popup(popup) + Dialog::new(cx).items_start().justify_start().popup(popup) ``` ### Base single-line Input alignment A Base single-line input fills its frame and vertically centers its line. If a tall frame relied on top placement, use a one-line-height frame for the previous appearance. Multiline and styled Component input layout is unchanged. ([#3278](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3278)) ### Accordion content lifetime and pagination limits Closed Accordion content unmounts after its close spring settles, dropping element/keyed state held inside the panel. Preserve durable state in entities. Under reduced motion this optimization keeps content mounted. Pagination ellipsis menus cap hidden-page choices at the nearest 100; use successive menus to reach farther pages. ([#3279](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3279)) ### Form visibility and attachment presentation `Field::visible(false)` now hides the field instead of being ignored. Attachment has new default chip sizing, radius, status overlays and failure colors; review applications that depended on its former content-sized geometry. ([#3269](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3269), [#3195](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3195)) ### Chart labels and duplicate x values LineChart/AreaChart position duplicate x values at their individual indices, matching hover. Vertical BarChart with labels reserves slightly more top space (bars draw 2px shorter); PieChart tooltip labels are configured separately from leader-line labels. ([#3262](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3262), [#3217](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3217), [#3176](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3176)) Thank you to everyone
